paragraphs: I am applying for your fictional Junior Data Analyst role. Its focus on checking query results and explaining research findings matches the analysis work I practised in my course project.
For that project, I wrote SQL queries to summarize a sample dataset and compared query outputs with spreadsheet totals. I documented the checks and presented the findings to my course group.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss the role and share that project. This letter and candidate are fictional demonstration material.
